merge into t_cx_share_mold_info a USING (
select #{item.id, jdbcType=DOUBLE} id, #{item.groupName,jdbcType=VARCHAR} group_name, #{item.embryoCode,jdbcType=VARCHAR} embryo_code, #{item.sapCode,jdbcType=VARCHAR} sap_code, #{item.shareMoldNum, jdbcType=DOUBLE} share_mold_num, #{item.remark,jdbcType=VARCHAR} remark, #{item.delFlag,jdbcType=VARCHAR} del_flag, #{item.createBy,jdbcType=VARCHAR} create_by, #{item.createTime, jdbcType=DATE} create_time, #{item.updateBy,jdbcType=VARCHAR} update_by, #{item.updateTime, jdbcType=DATE} update_time from dual
) b ON ( a.group_name = b.group_name AND a.sap_code = b.sap_code AND a.del_flag = '0' ) WHEN MATCHED THEN UPDATE
a.share_mold_num = b.share_mold_num , a.remark = b.remark , a.update_by = b.create_by , a.update_time = sysdate
WHEN NOT MATCHED THEN INSERT ( a.id, a.group_name, a.sap_code, a.share_mold_num, a.remark, a.del_flag, a.create_by, a.create_time ) values ( SEQ_CX_SHARE_MOLD_INFO.NEXTVAL, b.group_name, b.sap_code, b.share_mold_num, b.remark, 0, b.create_by, sysdate )
